svg.title: NDCC club song
svg.desc: Newcomb and District Cricket Club song. Two verses, chorus and outro, in maroon and blue with the original club crest.

g.text: All the fans begin to shout,
We will win without a doubt!
To the old maroon and blue.
The dinosaurs are on the ground,
We play it hard, we play it fast,
Others may fall by the shores,
To the old maroon and blue.
